parts:
Hello, 

When using the following code to create a table: 

    tableOne <- datatable(as.data.frame(t1), escape = FALSE, rownames = T, container = sketch, extensions = list('Buttons' = NULL, 'ColReorder' = NULL, 
'RowReorder' = NULL), 
                          options = list(dom = 'BRrltpi', ordering=F, autoWidth = FALSE, lengthMenu = list(c(10, 50, -1), c('10', '50', 'All')), ColReorder = TRUE, RowReorder = TRUE, 
                                         buttons = list('copy', 'print', list(extend = 'collection', buttons= c('csv', 'pdf'), text = 'Download'), I('colvis'))), 
                          class = 'table-bordered table-condensed table-striped table-compact') %>%
      formatStyle(colnames(t1)[1],
                            target = 'row',
                            backgroundColor = styleEqual(c("  "), c('silver')))

the table is generated correctly when I display it in R.  However as soon as I try to open it using shiny.  All of the entries are filtered out and the bottom displays: 
Showing 0 to 0 of 0 entries (filtered from 8 total entries)

Do you know what is causing this? And how  I can fix it?
